Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.label: ammo switching
Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.description: This weapon can switch between multiple ammunition presets. Use the gizmo to queue a switch; the wielder walks over to change ammo and a short cooldown applies afterwards. Each preset may alter the projectile, range and accuracy.

Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.label: threshold protection
Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.description: Incoming hits are compared against a damage threshold. Depending on configuration, hits above or below the threshold can be fully blocked, clamped, or let through, and each block may consume a protection charge. Charges can be replenished with materials or recharge over time. See the "Threshold protection" category for the exact numbers.

Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.label: environmental requirement
Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.description: This recipe can only be worked when the workbench's room meets specific environmental conditions such as cleanliness, light level, temperature, pressure or gravity. Bills are suspended while the conditions are not met. Some linked facilities may waive these requirements.

Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.label: heavy equipment
Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.description: Only pawns that meet a body size requirement, or belong to the listed races, wear the listed apparel, or carry the listed implants or genes can equip this. Others cannot pick it up as a weapon.

Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.label: multiple turrets
Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.description: This unit mounts one or more sub-turrets that acquire and fire at targets independently of its main weapon. Each turret can be given a forced target, toggled between automatic and manual fire, and may accept its own weapon or ammunition.

Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.label: internal battery
Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.description: This building carries its own battery. While connected to a powered grid it charges the battery; if the grid loses power it keeps running on the battery until it is drained. Switching the building off puts it in standby, where it stops working but charges faster.

Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.label: deployable
Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.description: This item can be carried by a pawn and deployed in the field as a building. A drafted pawn carrying it can place it directly on an open spot; deploying takes time and the area must be clear.

Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.label: biochemical protection
Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.description: While worn, this apparel prevents the wearer from contracting diseases and infections from the environment or from wounds.
